title: Great but tiny
text: Great but tiny. I wish this was a little bigger in circumference but other than that it was all I needed. I wanted white porcelain over the ceramic and that left me with few choices.

product_metadata.title: Sweese 803.103 Porcelain Grater Plate for Ginger, Garlic and Onion, 4 Inches, Navy
features: ★ MULTI-PURPOSE - It's a nice kitchen plate to grate ginger, garlic, onions and spices; also a great dish to make fruit, carrot or tomato paste for your BABY in minutes. It measures 4.4 inches in diameter and the grating area is 2 inches. Large size for collecting many juices.

★ PRACTICAL DESIGN - Sharp teeth help you quickly shred ginger or fruit. The raised teeth extract ginger pulp while leaving behind fiber. Two holders on the side help to pour juice out and hang up the grater easily. Three gel on the bottom help to hold it in place firmly.
★ HEALTHY MATERIAL - The grater dish is made of hard-paste porcelain, chip and stain resistant. Healthy to use.
★ EASY TO CARE - Porcelain is stain-FREE, easy to clean. No leavings and juice could stick to the dish. Heat-resistant, dishwasher and microwave safe.
★ GREAT FOR GIFT - It is well wrapped in a gift box, ideal for housewarming, wedding gift for friends.
